facts.evidence: **Q3 2026 Revenue**: Expected to be in the range of $61-64 billion.

**Legal Proceedings**: The company has $2.4 billion in charges related to legal proceedings, impacting expenses. / "including $2.4 billion in legal charges" (the $1.18 billion of May 2026 severance expense is not mentioned anywhere in the brief)
**Free Cash Flow**: $784 million, down from $8.55 billion in Q2 2025. (the $31.86 billion of cash flow from operating activities is not stated, and free cash flow is not labelled non-GAAP)
**Capital Expenditures**: Expected to be in the range of $130-145 billion. (brief omits that this was narrowed from the prior $125-145 billion outlook)

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $60.80 billion.
Revenue was up 28% year-over-year.
Net income was $15.85 billion.
Net income was down 14% year-over-year.
Operating margin was 31%.
Operating margin was down from 43% in Q2 2025.
Free cash flow was $784 million.
Free cash flow was down from $8.55 billion in Q2 2025.
Family of Apps revenue was $60.37 billion.
Family of Apps revenue was up 28% year-over-year.
claims.note: The release gives FoA revenue of $60,370M vs $47,146M but discloses no segment growth percentage; the 28% requires a calculation the release does not show.

claims.claim: Reality Labs revenue was $431 million.
Reality Labs revenue was up 16% year-over-year.
claims.note: The release shows $431M vs $370M but no segment growth percentage; the 16% requires a calculation the release does not show.

claims.claim: Advertising revenue was $59.36 billion.
Advertising revenue was up 27% year-over-year.
Ad impressions delivered across the Family of Apps increased 14% year-over-year.
Average price per ad increased 12% year-over-year.
Meta expects third quarter 2026 revenue in the range of $61-64 billion.
Meta expects full year 2026 total expenses in the range of $165-169 billion.
The full year 2026 expense outlook includes $2.4 billion in legal charges.
Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures in the range of $130-145 billion.
Capital expenditures were $31.08 billion for Q2 2026.
Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $90.26 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Long-term debt was $83.66 billion as of June 30, 2026.
The company recorded $2.4 billion of charges related to legal proceedings, impacting expenses.
The May 2026 headcount reduction impacted 8,000 employees.
The 8,000 impacted employees will no longer be reflected in headcount by the end of Q3 2026.
claims.note: The release says the majority of the approximately 8,000 impacted employees will no longer be reflected in headcount by the end of Q3 2026; the brief applies it to all of them.
